title: Purchased tickets cannot be reached when the app fails to load or sign in
summary: Reviewers report the app refusing their login with a generic error, logging them out after every close, or hanging on a loading screen. Because tickets are only available in the app, a failed sign-in means no way into the event. Reinstalling does not resolve it.

evidence.quote: Won't even let me log in to my account because am error occurs everytime
Can't log in, it shows a web page error after entering login credentials
can't log in as it's stuck trying to get me to select my favourite teams and the skip option doesn't work
can't even log in. just keeps loading then says error
having login problems after updating once again. Made me update, now it won't open
The app literally won't load any pages I click on
it loves to stay on a infinite loading screen when I select the my tickets tab

workarounds: use the browser instead of the app

title: Tickets are only available in the app and the barcode often will not display
summary: Reviewers describe being required to install the app to see a ticket they have already paid for, then finding the barcode unavailable or pushed into a separate wallet app. Screenshots are blocked, so there is no fallback when the display fails.

evidence.quote: they forced me to download the app just so I could view my ticket
your site says I can get my ticket on the app OR in my digital wallet
I have to use this joke of an app to enter a forthcoming gig
this app won't display the barcode on my most recent tickets
When I tried to download the tickets, they weren't available

workarounds: collect tickets at the venue box office

title: Lessons hang, crash, or fail to load their audio
summary: Reviewers report the app freezing at the end of a lesson without saving progress, failing to load character or writing exercises, and producing no sound on activities that need it. Several say it began after a recent update and that restarting does not help.

evidence.quote: I cannot progress beyond this point as the app keeps hanging after the lesson
it also won't load kana or other character / writing lessons
Your app just stopped working on my iPhone 15 Plus. It crashes and would not start
A lot of bugs like no sounds, the word is different from what it pronounced
There are so many broken activities with buttons that don't select, or don't produce any sound

workarounds: wait several minutes for a lesson to load

title: The energy system stops free lessons after a few minutes
summary: Reviewers describe a change to an energy or battery system that exhausts after one or two lessons, leaving free users unable to continue until it refills. Several say this makes sustained practice impossible without paying.

evidence.quote: They changed to a energy system and u can barely finish 2 lessons before you are out of energy
since adding the energy that drains after 1-2 lessons, unless you pay you can only do 5-10mins every 25hrs
my app is broken and it's putting me at a huge disadvantage

title: Free trials become a paid year without warning and refunds are refused
summary: Reviewers report being charged for a full year immediately after starting what was presented as a free trial, including some who say they cancelled before it ended. The in-app response is that no refund is available.

evidence.quote: Signed up for a free trial to stop the ads and was immediately charged 189 for the whole year
I believed your one week free trial and cancelled it 2 days before. but then I noticed I have been charged for 1 year subscription
just take hundreds of dollars off your card with no consent and no way to get it back

workarounds: request a refund through the app store rather than the app

title: Refunds are refused after problems with a stay
summary: Guests describe reporting a serious problem with a booking and being denied a refund, in several cases after one had already been agreed. Complaints include a cancellation the night before travel and charges for damage the guest says they did not cause.

evidence.quote: I got a bed bug bite and have shown evidence and airbnb refused to refund me
Host agreed to a refund. Then disputed it.
Airbnb's own rep calculated and we accepted a specific refund in writing
Host request for $$$ for clean their hot tub which we didn't use at all
6pm the night before we leave for our trip, our host decided to cancel our reservation

title: The app returns generic errors and basic actions silently fail
summary: Reviewers on both platforms report being unable to sign in, a repeating request failure message, and controls that do nothing when tapped. Uninstalling and reinstalling is described as having no effect.

evidence.quote: Can't log in. I just get a generic error message, even after uninstalling and reinstalling.
Uninstalled the app and reinstalled, no luck!
slow chats bugs in messaging , bookings failure
saving a place as a favourite did not work when you tapped the heart nothing happened

workarounds: open the listing before saving it

title: The free tier will not let you choose which song plays
summary: Free users describe being unable to pick a track from their own playlist, being forced into shuffle, and losing basic transport controls. Several report the app substituting recommended tracks for the playlist they selected.

evidence.quote: it doesn't give free users the loop button, puts it on a queue you can't even see or control
won't let you go back to a previous song and forces you to listen to your playlists on shuffle
won't let you actually choose what songs you want to listen without buying premium
it keeps telling me that I can't choose my own music or songs
this app isnt even playing the songs in my playlist it jst plays like 4 songs from my playlist

title: Playback pauses, restarts or cuts out on its own
summary: Reviewers describe music stopping without input, restarting from the beginning of a playlist, or cutting off and not resuming. Reports come from both platforms and from paying subscribers as well as free users.

evidence.quote: App keeps pausing my music then restarting to the beginning of the playlist
every time I open the app it pauses my music or it just completely cuts off the music
Spotify has its moments of working, but most times does not
the app keeps lagging and its been like this for the past month

title: Adverts interrupt every second song and cover the player
summary: Free users report audio adverts between almost every track, plus banner adverts obscuring album art, the liked songs list and search results. Several describe the frequency as having increased recently.

evidence.quote: Every song is followed up by an advert. When there isn't an audible advert, you get an advert obscuring the album art
the ads are so in your face it's exhausting, pop ups covering the albums
more than 2 ads after every 2 songs is more irritating
even though I got an add every 2 songs

title: Payments and transfers fail, leaving money unreachable
summary: Reviewers report being unable to send a payment, reach the wallet screen, or move a balance to their bank, each ending in a generic error. Several describe money that has left one account and not arrived in another, with no resolution from support.

evidence.quote: Have not been able to send a single payment. It just gives me an error message that says it can't be completed at this time.
I can't pay someone I have paid in the past.
I can't actually access this page because I keep getting an error every time I try to access it
I added money to my Venmo account and still couldn't get my order
It won't just come back into my Venmo like it's supposed to
A deposit was made to my account a week ago today.

title: Free trials convert to a paid year immediately and refunds are refused
summary: Reviewers describe accepting a trial and being charged for a full year straight away, in one case after the trial prompt appeared a second time. Others report repeated upgrade prompts leading to an accidental purchase that could not be reversed.

evidence.quote: Beware starting a free trial, the first time you accept it it says you're in the free trial
strava charged me a full years subscription immediately and I can't cancel even though it's only been a few days
Every day I get at least 10 notifications asking to sign up for the premium version

title: Refunds are refused, delayed, or issued as credit that cannot be used
summary: Travellers describe paying for a booking that did not materialise, cancelling within the stated terms, or buying cancellation cover, and then being refused the money back. Several report repeated promises of a refund within a set window that then passes.

evidence.quote: when I got there there was no car available so I requested a refund and they refused to give me my money back
You refused to refund our money
trying to get a partial refund because beds were wrong
I purchased flight cancelation due to the fact its based on work schedule

title: The app errors out and the support chat is unusable
summary: Reviewers report a repeating error on booking screens, reservations that do not appear after being made, and freezing that requires a restart. The in-app chat is described as slow, and the keyboard covers the field while typing.

evidence.quote: Then it freezes. Then it freezes your whole phone!
the app keeps saying error please try again every time I try I get the same error
Made a reservation and I is not showing up. Chat section is terrible. Freezes up constantly
cannot see while you are typing in the chat. very slow chat responses.

title: There is no way to reach a person about a problem with a ride
summary: Reviewers describe automated support that will not connect them to anyone, no support option in the app for riders, and unanswered reports of lost property or duplicate charges. Several say the only route offered leads back to a bot.

evidence.quote: the automated customer support does not let me contact the customer service
The app doesn't even have a customer support option.
the driver just cancel on me, everytime I use it now, same thing happens
if you ever need help your completely on your own, there is no help number for riders only drivers

title: The amount charged does not match the fare that was quoted
summary: Reviewers report final fares well above the quoted price, waiting-time fees applied when the rider was the one waiting, and cancellation fees charged after the driver cancelled. Several say reversing a charge requires contacting support, which is itself difficult.

evidence.quote: app gave wildly inaccurate fare cost. Pre booked from airport, quoted $126, ended up costing $176!
When I need to drive to the airport it it charged me double price. Always adds wait time fee
they charged me a cancellation fee then locked me out of my account

title: The app crashes, signs you out, and will not reopen without reinstalling
summary: Android reviewers report the app closing itself with a system bug notice, random sign-outs, and a state where it refuses to open until it is uninstalled and reinstalled. One describes two-step sign-in failing because switching to an authenticator resets the screen.

evidence.quote: Slack keeps crashing on my Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra running Android 16
Terrible app that crashes constantly, logs me out at random, and more often and not, it just wont open untill I uninstall and reinstall it
I can no longer sign in as we now require 2 step authentication

title: Meetings cannot be joined from the mobile app
summary: Android reviewers report being blocked from joining a meeting by an update prompt with no update available, by repeated verification requests, or by the app ejecting them when the camera is opened. Reinstalling is described as not helping.

evidence.quote: won't let me join work meetings saying I need to update, no update available
ask verification multiple times and information and after all I can't join the meeting
whenever i try to open my camera, i was forced to leave

title: Sign-in fails and a stale account cannot be removed from the app
summary: Android reviewers report being unable to get past the login screen, landing on an error page instead. One describes leaving an organisation and then being locked into signing in to an account that no longer exists, with no way to remove it or switch.

evidence.quote: it always prompts me to sign in to the now non-existent account when I open the app
I can't even sign in with my account
I can't even get past the login screen without being spit into an error page
